Done and deployed. The Camps feature is live in the admin panel.

**What was added:**

**New Camps tab** in the sidebar (between Import Data and Parents) with a tent icon.

**Backend endpoints:**
- `GET /api/admin/camps` — now returns full camp details (description, checks, grades, capacity, registered count)
- `GET /api/admin/schools` — lists all active schools for the camp form dropdown
- `POST /api/admin/camps` — create a new camp (school, title, date, time, status, capacity, description, checks, grades)
- `PUT /api/admin/camps/:id` — edit an existing camp
- `DELETE /api/admin/camps/:id` — deactivate a camp

**Admin panel UI:**
- **Add New Camp form** — school dropdown (auto-loaded from database), title, date picker, time, status (Upcoming/Active/Completed/Cancelled), capacity, description, checks, and grades fields
- **All Camps table** — shows title, school, date, time, status badge, capacity, registered count, and Edit/Delete action buttons
- **Search** — filter camps by title or school name
- **Edit** — click Edit on any camp row to load it into the form, make changes, and click Update Camp; Cancel button to exit edit mode
- **Delete** — click Delete to deactivate a camp (with confirmation dialog)
- Title cells have tooltips showing description, checks, and grades on hover

**Admin portal:** https://kidhero-health-sync-backend.rork.app/admin
